thesis_summary.thesis: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. (APD) is a global industrial gases company founded in 1940. **[Fact]** It sells atmospheric and process gases through three supply modes: on-site plants (take-or-pay contracts), merchant bulk delivery, and packaged cylinders. **[Fact]** FY2025 sales were **$12.0 billion** (down 1% versus FY2024), with geographic segments Americas, Asia, Europe, and Middle East and India. **[Fact]** The company also builds and operates large energy-transition projects, including the NEOM Green Hydrogen joint venture in Saudi Arabia and equity interests such as the 55% JIGPC joint venture. **[Fact]** CEO Seifi Ghasemi has led the company since July 2014.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may treat APD as a damaged cyclical chemicals name after **$3.7 billion** of FY2025 project-exit charges and a pending **$2.9 billion** pre-tax charge on further clean-energy exits (June 2026). **[Inference]** Generalists may anchor on GAAP losses and negative reported free cash flow during the NEOM build-out, underweighting the durable core: Americas, Asia, and Europe together generated roughly **$6.2 billion** of segment operating income in FY2025 before corporate drag. **[Fact]** Q2 FY2026 adjusted earnings per share rose to **$3.20**, up **19%** versus the prior-year quarter, suggesting core operations are recovering while growth-project capital is being cut. There is no dated predictive attribute; the setup is **descriptive** (impairment overhang + oligopoly core) rather than a timed equity yield curve.

key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 cash from operations $3.26B less estimated maintenance capital spending $1.35B, divided by 222.7M diluted shares (10-K FY2025); GAAP FCF negative due to NEOM/JIGPC growth capex
Core on-site/merchant oligopoly persists; project exits reduce growth capex drag; NEOM option not in base cash path

open_questions: Management capital allocation track record (Ghasemi era megaprojects) vs new exit discipline
Normalized owner cash: maintenance capex estimate ($1.35B) vs company-adjusted capex bridge
June 2026 $2.9B charge: final amount and cash settlement timing
NEOM probability and fair value for option overlay (not in base IRR)
